answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. A fable of per-task receipts records who did what, and the forge of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, converted to a slow vesting stream, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The whisper of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
